headline: As of 2026-10-06: 1,576,451 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 32 of 50 states, D+31.8 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 1,576,451 early/mail ballots cast so far across 32 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+31.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (387,232), Florida (231,289), Michigan (201,909).
